shared_elements: horizontal decorative border band framing the field
animal eye rendered with outlined almond shape
repeated ornamental motifs in a band (leaf/rosette-like)
justification: Both are low-relief profile animal images set within a field bounded above by a horizontal band of repeating ornament (leaf-like in A, rosettes in B), and both render the eye as a carefully outlined almond with a bulging pupil. However A shows a single monstrous bird-headed creature filling the panel with beak and clawed arms, while B shows a full-bodied naturalistic two-humped camel led by a walking human figure in a processional register, so the subjects and their relationships differ substantially.
